visualCharacteristics.purpose: Inline story image that text wraps around, as on the source .textImage-left / .textImage-right.
visualCharacteristics.layout: Float left/right at every width like the source: 400px wide (the most common authored source width), max-width 100% (full column width on mobile), margin 0 0 10px 20px for right (mirrored for left). Caption below the image: 20px top padding, 14px/21px, italic, body text color. The section must clear floats (the block wrapper should not overflow the next section).
visualCharacteristics.tokens: Use only the semantic tokens in styles/brand.css (multi-brand). Caption color var(--color-text-muted).

contentPattern.structure: Block table 'Image (left)' or 'Image (right)' with one cell: the picture, optionally followed by a caption paragraph (italic). The block sits between default-content paragraphs of a story body; the text that follows it in the same section wraps beside it.
contentPattern.variants: left: floats left, text wraps on the right. right: floats right, text wraps on the left. No option (plain 'Image'): full-width image, no float.
contentPattern.notes: Must not break when the caption is missing or when the author puts the caption in a second row. Used in 25 stories (left in 13, right in 21).
contentPattern.example: Image (right): picture + italic caption 'Sarah Miller with her two daughters...'

reuseGuidance: Use inside story bodies for a photo the following paragraphs wrap around: Image (left) or Image (right). Plain Image gives a full-width inline image. Keep the block in the same section as the text that should wrap.
